claim_scores.justification: The replication used the exact Table 1 configuration, matched the expected density range and structure, and L1 errors are close to the paper's values.
L1 errors at N=128, 256, 512 are within 30% of the paper's, and convergence rates (0.86, 1.29) bracket the paper's reported range (0.64-1.18).

claim_scores.claim: C3 (MR sparser than AMR in mesh compression)
claim_scores.justification: Ordering (MR < AMR) and MR/AMR ratio (0.80 vs 0.89) are reproduced; absolute values differ due to reference grid size and averaging window, but the core structural claim holds.

claim_scores.claim: C4 (MR shows slightly enhanced convergence and better accuracy per active cell)
claim_scores.justification: Pareto analysis shows MR dominates AMR by 5-10x at all thresholds, confirming the qualitative direction of the claim, though tested post-hoc rather than in-loop.
No in-loop adaptive time-stepping harness was implemented, so CPU-time scaling was not measured.
Only a single implementation was used; cross-code runtime comparison is out of scope.

parsed.overall_reasoning: All core structural and quantitative claims (C1–C4) are independently reproduced with high or medium confidence using a comparable FV solver. Claims C5 and C6 were not tested due to reasonable scope limits (no in-loop adaptivity or cross-code runtime comparison).
parsed.one_line_summary: All core accuracy and mesh compression claims replicated; CPU-time trends not tested; verdict: PARTIAL.
